opening.argument: The video offers a purported free $100 Starbucks gift card and tells viewers to click an external link to get it. The stated condition is only answering a couple of simple questions, making the promised reward appear easy to obtain. The speaker's reassurance that the link “seems legit” reinforces that pitch. No money request is stated, and the material does not establish whether the offer is authorized or fulfilled. Those limits do not change the observable reward-for-action promotion.
